titulo: One word on the heavy box
caption:
One word on the heavy box

The box looked light and wasn't. One word on a label, and whoever lifted it next knew.

A label costs three seconds, and the next person to lift it won't have to find out the hard way.

For whoever writes heavy on the box for whoever lifts it next.

Choose friction.

More of this: link in bio.

alt: A short film with no voice, with music. A room with a long table. At the right a big brown cardboard box, and a cream label that says heavy floating above it, tilted. A ink-black block figure with narrowed white eyes walks up from the left, its eyes go wide, it leans in and the label slides down onto the front of the box, which settles with a little wobble. Its eyes turn happy with a pulse. The text stays: me labeling it for whoever lifts it next.
